 Rock News When We Were Young 2027 Lineup Announced: Blink-182, Pierce the Veil, Limp Bizkit and More
 by Staff November 17, 2026 November 17, 2026 
 The festival returns to Las Vegas next October after taking 2026 off 
 When We Were Young is back.
 After sitting out 2026, the Las Vegas festival has announced its return to the Las Vegas Festival Grounds on Saturday, October 16, 2027. blink-182 and Pierce The Veil will headline, with Limp Bizkit and Third Eye Blind right below them on a lineup of more than 60 acts.
 Check out the full lineup below.
 This will be the festival’s fifth edition in Las Vegas, and 7-Eleven is the presenting sponsor. It’s also a change in format. After two-day editions in 2023, 2024 and 2025, the 2027 festival is billed as a single Saturday.
 blink-182 return as headliners for the third time, after topping the bill in 2023 and 2025. For Pierce The Veil, it’s a big step up. The San Diego post-hardcore band, who opened for blink-182 on their 2024 arena tour, now share the top line with them.
 Below them, the bill covers more than 25 years of the scene. There’s nu-metal from Limp Bizkit and ’90s alt-rock from Third Eye Blind. Circa Survive, The Used, Thrice, Thursday, Underoath, Poison The Well and Story Of The Year bring the post-hardcore and screamo era. All Time Low, Simple Plan, New Found Glory, Taking Back Sunday, Sleeping With Sirens and The Maine carry the pop-punk and emo core. The bill reaches back to the ’80s with The Psychedelic Furs and to the 2000s pop charts with Michelle Branch, Natasha Bedingfield and Ashlee Simpson. And newer bands like Hot Mulligan, Movements, Drain, State Champs, Taylor Acorn and LØLØ show where the scene has gone since.

 Tickets
 The presale begins Friday, Nov. 20, at 10 a.m. Fans can sign up at  whenwewereyoungfestival.com  to get a presale passcode. According to the festival’s release, the guaranteed lowest-price GA tickets will be available only during the first hour of the presale. GA, GA+ and VIP tickets will be offered, along with VIP Cabana packages.
 Why 2026 Was Skipped
 On Feb. 27, 2026, the festival announced it would skip the year. Organizers said they were taking 2026 off “to give this festival the care it deserves,” and promised, “This isn’t goodbye — it’s just a pause.” They didn’t give a specific reason. Some industry coverage pointed to a crowded festival market and the uncertainty facing several other Live Nation festivals. ( We covered the cancellation here. )
 When We Were Young first ran as a one-off in Santa Ana, California, in 2017. It became a national event in 2022, when it moved to Las Vegas with My Chemical Romance and Paramore as headliners. It sold out quickly and ended up adding dates. Since then it has been headlined by blink-182 and Green Day (2023), My Chemical Romance and Fall Out Boy (2024), and blink-182 and the reunited Panic! At The Disco (2025).
